label: Latest progress prerelease
new: Added multi-cell floor and wall painting in one purchase. Check the cell count and net price before paying. Cancel without charge.
Added moving and selling for owned walls. Paid values and refunds are preserved. Compatible older doors can use a full-cell opening.
Improved furniture placement to use its owned footprint and current occupants. Empty service space and future routes do not enlarge the footprint.
Improved land expansion in all four directions. Buying land immediately reveals unowned plots along every connected edge.
Changed new parking purchases to 50,000 coins. Existing parking keeps its ownership and original paid value.
Removed the free starter bin from new cafes. Bins remain optional at 65 coins. Existing entitlements and owned bins are preserved.
Removed stove upgrade purchases and level bonuses. All stoves use base cooking speed. Valid existing stoves keep their identity, ownership and value.
Improved dirty-dish drop-off at occupied sinks. Waiters can use a reachable sink while washing continues, or another reachable sink when full.
Improved Settings, Help and Updates with compact matching panels, consistent text and accessible close and back controls. Added optional FPS statistics in Help.
Improved saving feedback in the Save button. Saving progress and completion appear inside the button.
Added local play and embedded Google-account play to the itch entry. Local and account progress stay separate. Direct Firebase play remains supported.
Added a responsive Music panel with song selection, volume and playback controls.
Improved automatic saving to save changed progress every five seconds. Manual Save and Apply remain immediate.
Improved Decorate controls. Cancel restores the whole session, including furniture sales. Apply keeps all session changes.
Changed newly started meals to 25 seconds of eating. Saved meals keep their stored durations.
fixed: Fixed decorations shifting when moving the camera while hovering over a parcel.
Fixed dragged furniture highlighting outside its footprint. Valid placement is green. Overlaps and unowned floor are red.
Removed floor-paint validity outlines. The installed material preview and natural tile seams are preserved.
Fixed isolated doorways counting as usable entrances. Customer entrances must connect to a reachable corridor.
Fixed checkout counters floating above the floor. Cashier and customer payment contacts now align with the worktop.
Fixed the outside oak hiding nearby street characters that should appear in front.
Fixed staff rings drawing over solid furniture or under rugs. Rings keep their rotation and pause behavior. Their outer diameter matches one tile side.
Fixed staff idle-home assignments after recovery replaces the game state. This also applies when the roster count and model revision stay unchanged.
Improved mobile save-choice explanations and comparison cards. Fixed dragging in Settings activating buttons instead of scrolling.
Fixed the Update Notes header and panel margins leaving too little space for reading and scrolling.
Improved the Update Available notice with the shared theme and a centered desktop layout. Mobile safe-area fitting is preserved.
Fixed frozen cloud-save handoffs after late or uncertain network responses. Recovery does not take another native snapshot or repeat a confirmed save.
Fixed delayed saves losing their original handoff authority. Combined concurrent ownership renewals. Confirmed handoffs no longer rewrite the ownership lease.
Fixed initial cloud-save, recovery and ownership-start reads waiting indefinitely. Unavailable responses open protected Recovery instead of being treated as empty saves.
Improved account and page cleanup during cancellation, reload and account changes. Save ownership and pending progress stay protected.
Fixed Recovery device labels showing information from unrelated archived copies. Labels stay with their exact validated save records.
Fixed timed-out and closed update checks leaving requests open. Pending confirmation waits now finish.
Fixed ground rendering after the game state is replaced. Reused unchanged shop price fonts and checkout work instead of rebuilding them.
Fixed temporary CrazyGames music download failures with limited retries and cleanup. Existing audio and preferences are preserved.
Fixed served meals leaving customers waiting for cooking to finish.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Fixed Google-account handoff acknowledgment when the current device renews its ownership lease.
Fixed account autosaving after the browser journal connection closes or its ownership lease expires while away.
Fixed repeated cloud-save choices while preserving and exporting earlier protected copies.
Refreshed the account/local entry presentation while keeping local and Google-account progress separate.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Fixed release validation for hotfix versions while preserving previous update notes and cloud-rollout limitations.

history.label: Developer preview
fixed: Corrected release metadata and atlas dependency binding so the reviewed 0.1.10a fixes can be delivered.

history.label: Developer preview
new: When two different saves need your decision, compare Coins, Last saved and Device before choosing which progress to continue.
Switch to this device explicitly. A connected active game pauses and saves before handing control over.
A new-version notice lets you save and update, or choose Later. Updating waits for cloud confirmation.
fixed: Old cached progress without new changes now loads the latest cloud save automatically.
Unsynced progress stays protected during interrupted connections, device switching and save conflicts.
Improved recovery controls and same-tab continuation after a confirmed update.
Cloud changes remain subject to the coordinated server rollout; an older open tab may need to reopen the current game.
Fixed growing WebGL handle storage during repeated rendering-resource creation and cleanup.
Improved overview camera bounds, input ownership and neighborhood visibility.
When cloud saving is refused, pending progress can be exported before reopening the updated game.

history.label: Developer preview
new: A shorter, skippable tutorial with quick service explanations.
Customers now queue outside when your café is full.
Buy a four-space parking lot for 2,000 coins and welcome customers arriving by car.
More street scenery, passing traffic and bus-stop visitors.
New 60/120 FPS options and a diagnostic log in Settings.
Google-account cloud saves are available as a preview.
fixed: Clearer sign-in and loading guidance.
Improved camera movement, Fit and decorating visibility.
Improved wall, door and window placement, replacement and decoration refunds.
Fixed layering and details for trees, cookware, drink machines and cleaning tools.
Simpler Pause-only controls, with saving status moved into Settings.
More reliable saves, direct cleanup without bin trips, and safer background pause/resume.
This is a developer preview. Cross-device cloud saves and device compatibility are still being verified.
